title: Longest books
statementMd:
The 5 longest books by page count, longest first (break ties by title).

Expected columns: `title`, `pages`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
hints: Sort by pages descending, then title.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title, pages FROM books ORDER BY pages DESC, title LIMIT 5;
```
